expectations.text: Identifies that `upstream-main` is workflow-writable only and cannot be pushed to directly
expectations.evidence: Section 1: 'The only writer allowed is the upstream-sync.yml workflow... Human pushes to it are blocked by branch protection.'

expectations.text: Closes the CONFLICTING PR (#99) and opens a replacement, rather than trying to fix in place
expectations.evidence: Section 2 step 1: `gh pr close 99 --repo zjean/server --comment 'Superseded...'`; step 6 opens new PR

expectations.text: Cuts a resolution branch off `main` (e.g. `sync/upstream-YYYY-MM-DD`) and merges `origin/upstream-main` into it with `--no-ff`
expectations.evidence: Section 2 step 2: `BRANCH=sync/upstream-${DATE}; git checkout -b "${BRANCH}" origin/main; git merge origin/upstream-main --no-ff --no-edit`

expectations.text: Calls out i18n JSON (`frontend/src/i18n/*.json`) as the common/typical conflict pattern
expectations.evidence: Section 3 has full i18n conflict guidance with example conflict marker block and resolution rules

expectations.text: Uses `--repo zjean/server` on `gh pr create` for the replacement PR
Explicitly reminds the user to use **merge commit** (not squash) when merging the replacement PR
expectations.evidence: Section 5 is entirely about this: 'Use "Create a merge commit" — not "Squash and merge".' with explanation of why dropdown defaults to squash
